_comment: The game's texts in other languages (Game.Core Loc, docs/recipes/add-language.md). languages: each language's code and its own name, English first; Settings shows a Language button once there are two. texts: one table per language other than English, from the English text (as it appears in the UXML files, Loc.T("...") calls, worlds.json and the level titles) to the translation. A text a table lacks is shown in English; npm run check lists every missing one.
